decided: 2026-10-07 by the coordinator under the operator's delegation (operator may override)
committed_before_any_generation: yes: committed before any E6 generator data or held-out-generator work exists on any branch
pool_rule: every 0.3 public benchmark whose families-v1 tier is 'none' (zero coverage in the 150k mix); ForecastBench (48) is retired and not in the pool
procedure: key(n) = sha256(f'heldout-draw-v1:{seed}:{n}') as hex, for each catalog id n in the pool; sort the pool by key ascending; the first 9 are FROZEN, the other 9 are GENERATABLE. No benchmark is forced in or out; the draw is the draw.
frozen_rule: No training data, distillation set or generator may ever target a FROZEN benchmark or its task family (families-v1 'family'). harness.heldout.check_record / check_generator refuse them. Generatable benchmarks may receive generated training data (PR #92 E6); once they do, they move to tier same_family in a new families-vN.
second_proxy_planned: An independent second new-domain proxy: a frozen set of held-out task GENERATORS (3-5 decision formats absent from both the Index and our data), defined and committed before use, never trained on. Not built yet.
